title: Slovakian Christmas Potato Dumplings
description: A festive and delicious Slovakian dish, perfect for the holiday season, made with potato dumplings, topped with a light and creamy sauce.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated potatoes, all-purpose flour, caraway seeds, salt, and sugar.
Beat in the eggs and milk until well combined.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into dumplings.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the dumplings are done, add them to the skillet with the melted butter and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot, topped with a light and creamy sauce made with sour cream and chives.
